scope: Actual DLAA/RTX40 NR enhanced tags with independent real GPU readers and production Session/Interop completion-fence handling; scripted Streamline APIs
readerImplementation: Separate same-device DIRECT queue, gated actual shared HUD-less texture copy into owned readback, queue-only completion signal; CPU releases only independent gate
healthyContract: Completion fence/value returned through scripted public state API to production Session and Interop
AfterPresent returns while genuine reader is pending
Next D3D11 producer waits for actual reader completion and preserves old enhanced bytes
Stop -> bridge Drain -> NR/SR retirement waits for actual last reader before rebuilding at new extent
Same Session resumes with monotonic tokens at the second native extent

failureCases.reader-state-error: Public state query error remains Streamline fault; no reader retry

negativeControls.prematureHudReadback: Eight genuine-pending/wait checks failed because the test readback drained the bridge early; moved UI observation before reader submission. No production defect claimed.
